runs: Holistic Pregnancy Course is offered by Amra Asha Educational Trust, a trust registered in India ("Holistic Pregnancy", "we", "us", "our"). We respect the privacy of expecting parents, couples and everyone who learns with us.

This policy explains what personal information we collect, why we collect it, who we share it with, how long we keep it and the choices you have. It applies when you visit our website, enquire about a programme, make a booking, attend a session or use our learning services. It is published in line with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011, and is intended to meet the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its Rules as they come into force.
1. Information we collect
We collect only what we need to run our programmes:
Contact and booking details:
your name, email address, mobile number, city, the programme you choose and your booking history.
Payment details:
the amount paid, transaction reference and payment status. Card, UPI and bank details are collected and processed by our payment gateway, not by us, and we do not store them.
Account details:
login details for our learning platform, if your programme uses one.
Pregnancy and health-related information:
for example, your pregnancy stage or due date, or health information you choose to share in forms, sessions or messages.
Your contributions:
questions, comments, chat messages, feedback, and any stories, photos, videos or testimonials you choose to share.
Technical information:
device type, browser, IP address and cookie information when you use our website.
Information about your physical or mental health, including pregnancy-related information, is
sensitive personal data

under Indian law. We collect it only with your consent and only where it helps your learning experience. Please share only what you are comfortable sharing, and do not send us medical reports unless we specifically ask for them.
If you share information about your partner or another person, please make sure they are aware of it and agree.
2. Why we use your information
We use your information to:
register you and confirm your booking and payment give you access to live sessions (in English), recordings and course materials
send session links, reminders and service updates by email, SMS or WhatsApp
answer your questions and support requests
keep our services and your account secure, and prevent misuse
improve our programmes using feedback and overall (non-identifying) usage patterns
keep invoices and records, and meet our legal and tax obligations
We send promotional messages only with your consent. You can opt out at any time by using the unsubscribe link, replying "STOP" or writing to us.
3. Your consent

By submitting your details, ticking the consent box at booking or registration, or sharing information in our sessions, you consent to us using your information for the purposes above. You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to us at geethabafnadigital@gmail.com. Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it.
Withdrawal does not affect anything we did before you withdrew. If you withdraw consent for information we need to deliver a programme, we may not be able to continue providing that programme to you.
4. Your stories, confidentiality and testimonials

What you share in our programmes stays confidential. We do not publish your details, questions, pregnancy experiences or personal stories, use them in advertising, or share them with other participants or anyone else, unless you give us specific permission or the law requires it.

Joining a programme does not mean you agree to give a testimonial. Before we use any quote, photo, video, voice recording or story that identifies you, we will ask for your separate, written (including email or online) permission. You can withdraw that permission at any time, and we will stop any further use. Testimonials we publish are genuine and reflect individual experiences.
5. Who we share information with
We do not sell or rent your personal data.
We share it only as follows:
Service providers

who help us run our programmes, such as payment gateways, website and learning- platform hosting, video-conferencing, email, SMS and WhatsApp messaging, and customer-support tools. They receive only what they need, may use it only to provide their services to us, and must protect it.
Facilitators and guest experts
who deliver sessions, who may see participant names and questions in a session. They are bound by confidentiality.
Other participants

, only to the extent you choose: your name, video and messages are visible to others in live sessions you attend, and your name and mobile number may be visible to other members of any community or WhatsApp group you choose to join.
Authorities
, where the law requires, to comply with a court order or lawful request, or to protect anyone’s rights or safety.
A successor organisation
, if our programmes are transferred, with the same protections for your data.
6. Live sessions and recordings

Some sessions are recorded so participants can watch them later. We will tell you before a session is recorded. You can keep your camera off, use only your first name, and ask questions privately where the platform allows.

Recordings are made available only to enrolled participants for the access period stated for your programme. Participants must not take screenshots of, record, download or share any session, or share information about other participants.
7. Storage, security and transfers outside India

We use reasonable security practices, including restricted access to participant records, password protection and reputable service providers. Sensitive personal data is accessed only by people who need it to run our programmes. No online system is completely secure, but we work to protect your information.

Some of our service providers may store or process data on servers outside India. Where this happens, we use providers that maintain a level of data protection required by Indian law, and we follow any restrictions the Government of India places on transfers.
If a personal data breach affects you, we will inform you and the relevant authorities as required by law.
8. How long we keep information
Account, booking and learning information:
while your programme access is active, and then for as long as needed to handle questions or disputes, after which we delete or anonymise it.
Pregnancy and health-related information:
only for as long as it is needed for your programme. You can ask us to delete it sooner.
Invoices and payment records:
for the period required under tax and accounting laws (generally up to eight years).
Testimonials:
until you withdraw your permission.
Technical logs:
for at least one year, or longer if the law requires.
9. Your rights
You can ask us to:
tell you what personal data we hold about you and how we use it
correct, complete or update your data
erase your data, unless we must keep it by law
withdraw your consent
resolve a grievance about how we handle your data
record a person (nominee) who can exercise your rights if you die or become unable to do so

To use any of these rights, write to our Grievance Officer (details below). We may need to confirm your identity before acting on a request. You may also complain to the Data Protection Board of India once its procedures are in force, after first raising the matter with us.
10. Cookies

Our website uses essential cookies to work properly and, where enabled, analytics cookies to understand how visitors use it. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; the website may not work fully without essential cookies. Payment, video and messaging services we link to have their own privacy policies.
11. Children

Our programmes are for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal data of anyone under 18 without verifiable consent from their parent or lawful guardian. If you believe we have done so, please contact us and we will delete it.
12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The effective date at the top shows when it last changed. If we make significant changes, we will tell you by email or on our website before they take effect.

These Terms form a binding agreement between you and us for your use of our website and your participation in our programmes. Please read them carefully, together with our Privacy Policy, Refund Policy and Medical Disclaimer, which form part of these Terms. By ticking the acceptance box at checkout, making a payment or accessing a programme, you confirm that you have read and agree to them.
1. About our programmes

We offer educational, reflective and holistic learning for pregnancy and preconception. Programmes may cover wellbeing, lifestyle awareness, mindfulness, traditional practices and related topics, delivered through live online sessions, recordings and course materials.

Our programmes are educational. They do not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions or emergency care, and are not a substitute for care from your doctor. The modules, facilitators, schedule, duration and access period of each programme are described on its programme page.
No sex determination or sex selection.

We do not provide, promote or discuss any method, practice, ritual, diet or remedy for determining or selecting the sex of a child. Sex determination and sex selection are prohibited under the Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act, 1994.
2. Language

All live sessions are conducted in English. Course materials, captions, recordings and support are provided in English. We do not offer other languages unless we have confirmed this to you in writing before you pay.
3. Who can join

You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter into a binding contract under Indian law. If a participant is under 18, a parent or lawful guardian must make the booking and accept these Terms on their behalf, and remains responsible for their participation.
You must give accurate details when you register and keep them up to date.
4. Your health and safety

Before joining, and before trying any exercise, yoga, breathing practice, dietary change or other activity discussed in a programme, you should consult your own doctor or a qualified healthcare professional, particularly if your pregnancy is high-risk or you have any medical condition.
Taking part in any activity is voluntary. Stay within your comfort level and your doctor’s advice, and stop immediately if you feel unwell. Please read our Medical Disclaimer.
5. Fees and payment

Fees are shown in Indian Rupees on the programme page. Any applicable taxes, including GST, and everything included in the fee are shown before you pay. The full fee must be paid in advance to confirm your place, unless we have agreed otherwise in writing.

Payments are processed by our third-party payment gateway. Your booking is confirmed only after we receive the full payment and send you a confirmation. We may hold back access until payment is successful. Any additional paid service will be offered separately and charged only with your agreement.
6. Scheduling, access and changes

We may occasionally need to make reasonable changes to session dates, facilitators or the platform we use. We will tell you about significant changes in advance where possible and offer a suitable alternative date or equivalent access. If we cancel a programme, our Refund Policy explains your options.
Missing a session does not by itself entitle you to a refund. If a recording or replay is promised for your programme, you will have access to it for the access period stated on the programme page.
7. Your account and access

Your access is personal to you (and your partner, if the programme includes couples). Do not share your login details or session links with anyone else. You are responsible for activity on your account. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorised use.
8. Respectful participation
Please respect other participants’ privacy and dignity. You must not:
record, screenshot, download or share sessions or course materials
share other participants’ stories, images, contact details or personal information
harass, abuse or discriminate against anyone
post misleading, unlawful, obscene or promotional content
disrupt sessions or interfere with our platforms

If you breach these rules, we may give you a warning, or suspend or end your access after a fair review. In serious cases, such as harassment or sharing another participant’s private information, we may suspend access immediately while we review.
9. Intellectual property
All course videos, recordings, slides, text, practices, designs and branding belong to us or to contributors who have licensed them to us, and are protected by copyright and other laws.

Your purchase gives you a personal, limited, non-exclusive and non-transferable licence to access the programme for your own learning during the access period. You may not copy, resell, redistribute, publicly post, teach from or commercially use any course content without our written permission.
10. Refunds and cancellations
Our Refund Policy applies. In general, fees are non-refundable once payment is confirmed, except as set out in that policy or where a refund is required by law.
11. No guarantee of results

We do not guarantee conception, any pregnancy or birth outcome, your child’s development, any improvement in health, or any other specific result. Testimonials describe individual experiences and are not typical or guaranteed results.
12. Third-party platforms

We use third-party services such as video-conferencing, messaging and payment platforms to deliver our programmes. Your use of them is also subject to their own terms. We are not responsible for their outages, but we will work to restore access or provide an alternative.
13. Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law:
we are not liable for any indirect or consequential loss, or for outcomes resulting from relying on general educational information instead of professional medical advice; and
our total liability to you in connection with a programme will not exceed the fee you paid for that programme.

Nothing in these Terms limits liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that cannot be limited under Indian law, and nothing affects your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
14. Events beyond our control

We are not responsible for delays or failures caused by events beyond our reasonable control, such as natural disasters, epidemics, government orders, major internet or power outages, or failures of third-party platforms. If such an event affects a programme, we will offer a rescheduled session or equivalent access where possible.
15. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. If you have a concern, please contact us first so we can try to resolve it. Subject to your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, including your right to file a complaint where you live, the courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka will have jurisdiction over any dispute.
16. General

If any part of these Terms is found to be invalid or unenforceable, the rest remains in force. If we do not enforce a right immediately, we have not given it up. These Terms, together with the policies referred to above and the programme page, are the entire agreement between you and us about your programme.
We may update these Terms from time to time. The effective date at the top shows when they last changed. The version in force when you book applies to that booking.

Please read the programme page carefully before you enrol, including the language, duration, schedule, access period and what is included. This policy explains how payment, cancellations and refunds work and forms part of our Terms & Conditions. You will be asked to confirm that you have read it before you pay.
1. Full payment in advance
The full programme fee is payable in advance. Your place is confirmed only once we have received the full amount and sent you a confirmation, unless we have agreed otherwise in writing.
2. Cancellation by you
Because seats in each batch are limited and are reserved for you when you pay, fees are
non-refundable once your booking is confirmed
. This includes changing your mind, scheduling conflicts, not attending sessions, or choosing to withdraw part-way through a programme.
Please make sure the programme suits you, including English-language delivery, before you pay. If you have questions, write to us before booking and we will be happy to help.
3. Cancellation or significant change by us
If we cancel a programme or batch, you can choose either:
a place in a later batch of the same programme at no extra cost, or
a
full refund
if the programme had not started, or a proportionate refund for sessions not delivered if it had.

If we significantly change a programme’s schedule or content after you have paid, and the change does not suit you, please write to us within 7 days of being told about it, and we will offer you the same choice.
4. When the law requires a refund

This policy does not take away any rights you have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 or other laws that cannot be waived. If a service you paid for is not provided, is seriously deficient or was misrepresented, we will review your concern and provide the resolution the law requires, which may include a full or partial refund.
5. Duplicate or failed payments

If you were charged more than once for the same booking, or money was deducted but your booking was not confirmed, please contact us with proof of the transaction. Once verified, we will refund the extra or incorrect amount in full.
6. How refunds are paid

Approved refunds are initiated within 7 working days of approval, to the original payment method. Your bank or payment provider may take a further 5 to 10 working days to credit the amount. We do not charge any fee for processing a refund.
If you have a payment problem, please contact us before raising a dispute or chargeback with your bank, so we can resolve it quickly.
7. How to request a refund or raise a concern
Email us at geethabafnadigital@gmail.com with:
your name and registered email address or mobile number
the programme and batch you enrolled in
the payment date and transaction reference
a short description of the issue
We will acknowledge your request within 48 hours and tell you our decision within 15 working days.
Never share your full card details, OTPs or passwords with anyone, including us.

Our programmes, sessions, workshops, recordings, articles, messages and community discussions are educational and are meant for general information and supportive learning only. This disclaimer forms part of our Terms & Conditions.
1. Not medical advice

Holistic Pregnancy is not a medical service and is not a substitute for doctors, obstetricians, gynaecologists, midwives, mental-health professionals or any other qualified healthcare provider. Our programmes do not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, condition or pregnancy complication. Taking part does not create a doctor-patient relationship with us or with any facilitator or guest expert.
2. Talk to your doctor first

Every pregnancy is different. Before starting or changing any exercise, yoga, breathing practice, meditation, diet, fast, supplement, herb, medicine or other health-related practice discussed in our programmes, consult your own doctor or a qualified healthcare professional. This is especially important if your pregnancy is high-risk or you have any medical condition.

Any mention of foods, herbs, traditional remedies or practices is for general awareness only and is not a recommendation to take any medicine or supplement. Never stop, change or delay treatment prescribed by your doctor because of anything in our programmes.
3. Emergencies and warning signs
Do not use our programmes, community groups or messaging channels for urgent medical questions or decisions.

If you have bleeding, leaking fluid, severe pain, severe headache, blurred vision, fainting, difficulty breathing, reduced baby movements, a seizure, thoughts of harming yourself, or any other urgent or worrying symptom, contact your doctor, go to the nearest hospital or call emergency services immediately.
In India, call
for emergencies or
for an ambulance. For mental-health support, call Tele-MANAS on
. Do not wait for the next session or a reply from our team.
4. Your participation is at your own choice

Taking part in any suggested activity is voluntary and is your own decision. Listen to your body. Pause or stop any activity that causes pain, discomfort, dizziness or breathlessness, and seek medical advice. Do not attempt any physical activity your doctor has advised against.
5. No guaranteed outcomes

We do not promise or guarantee conception, any particular pregnancy experience, a complication-free pregnancy, any type of delivery or birth outcome, or any intelligence (IQ), emotional (EQ), spiritual (SQ), behavioural or developmental outcome for your child.
Traditional, reflective and spiritual concepts shared in our programmes are offered for learning and wellbeing. They are not claims of proven medical or scientific effectiveness.
6. No sex determination or sex selection
No sex determination or sex selection.

We do not provide, promote or discuss any method, practice, ritual, diet or remedy for determining or selecting the sex of a child. Sex determination and sex selection are prohibited under the Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act, 1994.
7. Guest experts and participant stories

Guest speakers, including qualified professionals, share general knowledge and their own experience. General comments made in a group session are not a personal medical consultation and should not be relied on as advice for your situation.
Testimonials and participant stories describe individual experiences. They are not typical or guaranteed results.
8. Language and questions
All live sessions are conducted in English. If anything is unclear, please ask us to explain. Questions about your own health should be directed to your doctor or healthcare professional.
9. Insurance

We do not provide medical, health, maternity, accident or life insurance, and we do not arrange or advise on insurance of any kind. Taking part in our programmes is not covered by any insurance held by us, our facilitators or guest experts.

Your health, pregnancy and maternity care, and any related insurance cover, remain your own responsibility. Please check your own policy for what it covers, including any waiting periods or exclusions.

We are not responsible for any decision by an insurer, including the rejection or reduction of a claim. Our programmes are educational services, not medical treatment, so our fees and invoices are generally not reimbursable under health insurance, and we do not issue medical certificates, prescriptions or treatment records for insurance purposes.
10. Your acknowledgement

By enrolling, you confirm that you have read and understood this disclaimer, that you will consult your doctor about your own health, and that you understand our programmes are educational and not covered by any insurance provided by us. This does not take away any of your legal rights.
